input.command:
python3 -c '
# Camera pose: (2.2071, 2.2071), heading 270 deg (-x)
# theta = 270 deg.
# Z_cam is towards -x, X_cam is towards +y.
# Chair 1 front legs: y_pix = 343.5
# col 195 and 227 -> center col = 211
d1 = 396.8 / (343.5 - 255.5)
xc1 = (211 - 255.5) / 256.0 * d1
world_x1 = 2.2071 - d1
world_y1 = 2.2071 + xc1
print(f"Chair 1 from obs 54: d={d1:.3f}, x={world_x1:.3f}, y={world_y1:.3f}")

# Chair 2 front leg: y_pix = 334.5, col = 340
# Chair 2 back leg: y_pix = 314.5, col = 373
d2_front = 396.8 / (334.5 - 255.5)
d2_back = 396.8 / (314.5 - 255.5)
d2 = (d2_front + d2_back) / 2
col2 = (340 + 373) / 2
xc2 = (col2 - 255.5) / 256.0 * d2
world_x2 = 2.2071 - d2
world_y2 = 2.2071 + xc2
print(f"Chair 2 from obs 54: d_front={d2_front:.3f}, d_back={d2_back:.3f}, x={world_x2:.3f}, y={world_y2:.3f}")
'
